detailed_descriptions.en: Strike from the darkness with the Raven Guard Champion Pack! Fast and lethal, this DLC grants you an exclusive Raven Guard Champion skin for the Assault class and a unique Bolt Pistol weapon skin. The cosmetics in this DLC can only be equipped in the game’s Operations and Eternal War modes. The Raven Guard Champion Pack is available as part of the Season Pass 2.
